lines.text: Jephthah's brothers drive him out, and he settles in the land of Tob, where worthless men gather around him.
When the Ammonites make war on Israel, the elders of Gilead fetch Jephthah from Tob to be their commander.
The elders call their father Gilead their witness, and the people make Jephthah leader and commander.
Edom and Moab refuse Israel passage, and Sihon of the Amorites gathers his people, encamps at Gilgal, and fights Israel.
Jephthah says Israel has lived in Heshbon for three hundred years, but the king of the Ammonites ignores his message.
